question: As of July 2025, Vinai Kumar Saxena is the Lieutenant Governor of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Vinai Kumar Saxena** was appointed as the **Lieutenant Governor of Delhi** on **May 23, 2022**, succeeding Anil Baijal. 
• The role of the **Lieutenant Governor (LG)** of Delhi is critical since Delhi is a **Union Territory** with a special status under Article 239AA of the **Indian Constitution**. 
• The Lieutenant Governor acts as the representative of the **President of India** in Delhi and oversees the administration of the **National Capital Territory (NCT)**. 
• **Vinai Kumar Saxena** had previously served as the **Chairman of Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)** before assuming the role of LG. 
• Delhi's governance structure involves the **LG**, the Chief Minister, and the elected legislative assembly, with the LG having certain discretionary powers in administrative matters, especially relating to public order, police, and land. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **About Delhi:** 
• Delhi, officially known as the **National Capital Territory (NCT)**, is India's capital city and serves as the country's political and administrative hub. 
• It is a **Union Territory** with partial statehood, governed under Article 239AA of the Constitution. 
• Key areas such as **public order, police, and land** fall under the jurisdiction of the **Central Government** and the LG, while other matters are handled by the elected government. 
• Delhi's legislative assembly has **70 elected members**. 
• **Role and Powers of the Lieutenant Governor:** 
• The Lieutenant Governor is appointed by the **President of India** and serves as the administrative head of the Union Territory. 
• In Delhi, the LG has special powers in matters of **public order, police, and land**, which are reserved for the Central Government. 
• The LG works closely with the elected government but also has discretionary powers as granted under the Constitution. 
• **Vinai Kumar Saxena:** 
• Before being appointed as the LG of Delhi, Saxena served as the **Chairman of the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)**, where he contributed significantly to promoting rural industries. 
• He has been recognized for his contributions to fostering sustainable development and rural employment in India. 
• **Governance in Other Union Territories:** 
• Unlike Delhi, most Union Territories are directly governed by the Central Government through the LG or Administrator, except for Puducherry, which also has a legislative assembly and partial statehood similar to Delhi. 
• Examples include **Ladakh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, and Chandigarh**, which are administered by LGs or Administrators appointed by the President. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Article 239AA:** 
• This article of the Indian Constitution provides a special status to the **National Capital Territory of Delhi**, allowing it to have a legislative assembly and council of ministers. 
• While the elected government handles most administrative matters, the LG retains authority over **public order, police, and land**. 
• **Delhi Government Structure:** 
• The Delhi government consists of the **Chief Minister**, the Council of Ministers, and the legislative assembly. 
• The LG serves as the link between the Central Government and the elected government of Delhi. 
• Disputes over jurisdiction between the LG and the Delhi government have occasionally arisen, especially in areas of administrative control. 
• **Current Developments:** 
• In recent years, the role of the LG in Delhi has been debated, leading to Supreme Court judgments clarifying the division of powers. 
• The **Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (Amendment) Act, 2021** further defined the powers of the LG in Delhi. </ul
